Campaign complete for **case-111** (`runs/dev-v2-case-111-r1`).

- **Resolved: candidate 1**, period 14.70211 days, K = 15.25 m/s
- Final support: **0.998009** (theta = 0.997)
- Used 4 of 6 observations

Path: three candidates (0, 1, 2) started nearly tied (~0.25–0.31 support each), with 3, 4, 5 already marginal. Slot 7 (early, discriminates 0-vs-2) split off candidate 0. Slot 11 then collapsed 0 and 2 in favor of candidate 1 while candidate 5 briefly rose. Slot 13 crushed candidate 5 and pushed 1 to 0.964. Slot 22 closed the last live pair (0-vs-1), crossing theta at 0.998. Each pick took the earliest slot tied for max separation on the currently dominant pair, so no budget was spent on deep jumps that weren't earned by the diagnostics.
